crossRefs.note: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…
and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought…
and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

parallels.note: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

translations.web: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
translations.bsb: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
translations.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
translations.asv: Then shall two man be in the field; one is taken, and one is left:
